summary: Fixed race condition by adding cross-platform file locking to TodoStorage

implementation_details.approach: Added cross-platform file locking using fcntl (Unix) and msvcrt (Windows)
key_changes: Added _lock_file and _unlock_file functions for cross-platform file locking
Added exclusive_access() context manager for atomic read-modify-write operations
Modified save() to acquire exclusive lock before writing
Added thread-local tracking for reentrant lock support
implementation_details.lock_file: Uses separate .lock file (e.g., .todo.json.lock) to avoid issues with atomic rename

risks: Lock files are not automatically cleaned up if process crashes (but locks are released by OS)
Windows msvcrt.locking has different semantics than Unix fcntl.flock
acceptance_criteria_met: Concurrent writes now serialize via file locking
No data corruption occurs under concurrent access
Lock acquisition and release are tested
